desc:
WHIPPED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored cream cheese frosting with a light, airy texture; Great for icing baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: Makes a perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: Eight 12 oz tubs of Betty Crocker Whipped Artificially Flavored Cream Cheese Frosting
features:
Key Benefits:

Ready to Use: No mixing required—just open and spread. Great for fast dessert prep.

Smooth Texture: Ideal for spreading or piping, especially on cooled cakes.

Kid-Friendly Flavor: Sweet milk chocolate taste loved by children and adults.

Gluten-Free: Safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities.

Shelf-Stable: No refrigeration needed until after opening.

 Benefits:

Time-Saving Convenience: Skip making frosting from scratch—ideal for spontaneous baking or beginners. 

Consistent Flavor & Texture: Delivers reliably smooth chocolate flavor every time. 

Kid- and Crowd-Friendly: Family-approved taste makes this frosting a go-to for familiar desserts.

Investor-Friendly Brand: Trusted brand with high availability and consistent quality.
ingredients: Sugar, Palm Oil, Water, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Monoglycerides, Salt, Cellulose Gel, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Cellulose Gum, Natural Flavor, Citric Acid, Yellows 5 & 6. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
